# UV set fixture

- `FourUV.glb`: exported for this project on 2026-11-06 by Blender 5.3.0 Beta through its bundled Khronos glTF Blender I/O
  v5.3.40, from `four-uv.blender.py` beside it. A quad with four UV maps, its base colour on the third and its emission on
  the fourth. Apache-2.0, as this repository.
